To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
GWMA control charts with FIR features have a good performance at low level of autoregressive data.
the GWMA-FIR control chart can detect a shift in autocorrelated processes with less time than a standard GWMA control chart.
the GWMA with FIR feature is more sensitive than the GWMA control charts to detect small or medium shifts at low level of autoregression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of the FIR feature to the GWMA control charts.
the development of GWMA control chart for autocorrelated data, which can detect a process mean shift in a shorter time and with less number of observations.
the performance of GWMA control chart when additional FIR feature is applied.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

GWMA control charts with FIR features are recommended for detecting small or moderate shifts in the process mean of an autocorrelated process at low level of correlation, and are also recommended to be used in detecting large shifts in the process at any level of autocorelation.
, in general, the GWMA control charts with FIR features are superior to GWMA control charts in terms of detecting process shifts.
GWMA control charts with FIR feature are more effective in detecting shifts in the process mean of an autocorrelated process than GWMA control charts without FIR feature.
